create_GuiInput_instance: create a GuiInput instance to hold keyboard and mouse input state for a simulation frame
check_key_held: check if a specific KeyCode is currently held down using the get_key method
check_key_down: check if a specific KeyCode was pressed this frame using the get_key_down method
check_mouse_button: check if a specific MouseButton is currently held or was pressed using get_mouse_button
reset_input_state: reset all discrete and continuous input states at the end of a frame using reset
